finding.title: Retry post-load manifest validation failures
finding.serviceFinding: After a successful manifest operation, sdk.Version mismatch or exception returns retryable ManifestUnavailable with Operation cleared and Phase advanced to 2. A later explicit acquisition skips the reset branch and never calls sdk.Manifest again; an older observer can also become successful if the version check recovers instead of preserving its original failure.
finding.requestedCorrection: Reset the manifest phase for this post-load validation failure path, so all ManifestUnavailable outcomes support explicit retry and old observers retain failure.
finding.attribution: Independent service finding; not locally reproduced or supplemented.
